params.prompt: The exact same black crystal prism, but now the camera is deep inside the glass: a macro refraction tunnel through the crystal interior, caustic light bending through the glass walls; separated strands of cyan, violet, magenta and amber light braid slowly through the interior like a frozen aurora inside stone; deep shadow fills the space between the strands; the strands converge toward a small bright white vanishing point glowing far ahead in the tunnel; macro crystal texture, exquisite detail, deep rich blacks, soft bloom; no text, no logos, no people
